positionPairing: adjacent ranks; recompute before each week
positionTieBreaker: total pins divided by total games, without rounding
qualification: unique third winners, then remaining teams by season points
seeding: multiple-third winner first; other third winners by season points; then wildcards by season points
substituteLimit: regular entering average in first third; current average thereafter
pending: equal points and exactly equal team averages in position rounds
ties for seeding among already qualified teams
